explanation: The Almighty Creator who judges all nations and calls His people back to justice according to prophecy.
A spokesperson appointed by God, namely Micah from Moresheth, who conveys God's message of judgment and hope.
The future time when God will bring every action under judgment to punish injustice and restore righteousness.
Actions in which the rich exploit, steal from, or threaten the poor with violence to seize their property.
The land that belongs to God, but is violated when people try to conquer others' fields and houses through fraud.
The promise that God's community will be restored with justice after a period of punishment and destruction.
